newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 1.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan to be left off of U.S. Super 301 list (in medical equipment import dispute).
Streamlined corporate tax proposal to cap rate at 35 percent.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Fishing tourists swept into raging sea near Keelung.
Taiwan to avoid U.S. trade sanctions.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Two leading Taiwan life insurers to step up property acquisitions.
U.S. leaves Taiwan off of Super 301 list.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan escapes Super 301 sanctions.
U.S. dollar rises to 32-month high against yen.
